Name: Super Administrator
Description: Has full access to all system features, including user management and system configuration.

Name: Administrator
Description: Manages academic and administrative functions with elevated permissions.

Name: Board Member
Description: Participates in governance and decision-making for institutional policies.

Name: Reviewer
Description: Reviews and evaluates academic submissions, such as theses or research papers.

Name: Student
Description: Enrolled student with access to academic resources and personal records.
